Translates between English and many other languages on this phone, without sending your text anywhere. Select text in any app and choose Translate, or share text or a picture to it.

Your text stays on this phone. The app goes online only to download a language when you ask for one: the translation files from Mozilla\'s storage at storage.googleapis.com, and the files for reading pictures from Tesseract on raw.githubusercontent.com. Those requests carry no account and nothing you have written, but those servers see this phone\'s internet address, as any server does. Mozilla\'s store runs on Google Cloud; Google, Mozilla and GitHub are separate from this app, and what they see of a download is covered by their own privacy policies. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Nothing is sent when you translate.

This app is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. It comes with no warranty: use it at your own risk.

Machine translation can be wrong. Do not rely on it where a mistake could hurt someone: medicine, law, safety, money.

This app is not made or endorsed by Mozilla, the Bergamot project, Tesseract or the authors of Offline Translator; their work is credited under Licenses.

Translate is free software: GPL-3.0-only, copyright wander wildwood. It began as a fork of Offline Translator by David Ventura, whose files keep their own notice (version 3 or any later version). What it is built on keeps its own licenses, listed below.

The translation files are not in the app. Each is downloaded when you ask for it from Mozilla\'s translation store (the one Firefox translates pages from), and Mozilla publishes them under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. They were trained by the Firefox Translations project on openly available collections of text. The files for reading pictures come from the tessdata_fast set of the Tesseract project, Apache 2.0. Not made or endorsed by Mozilla.

This app is made by wander wildwood, an independent developer: one person, not a company. That makes wander wildwood the data controller for anything the app itself handles, and that is very little: what you put in stays on this phone. The only things that go out are the language downloads described above: each is a request to Mozilla\'s store or to GitHub for one language file, and it carries the name of that file and nothing you have written. Nothing comes to the developer.
Write to email@wanderthe.dev, about your data or anything else.

Under the GDPR you can ask to see the data held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to limit or object to its use, to take a copy with you, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a data protection authority. Since the app keeps what it stores only on your phone, you can do most of this yourself: clear the text on the main screen, delete a language on the languages screen, clear the app\'s data in Android\'s settings, or uninstall the app.
